title: Link refusal
description: The body of a coded refusal on a gateway's link, application/json, unsigned: the link's transport authenticates it. The code, the names it concerns, who refused, and for a failure without a code the error's text. Every 410 on the link has this body, with the code and the from of the run's end at the gateway. A member Forager does not recognise is ignored.

error.description: The refusal code: the gateway's own, or the server's, passed on with its status.

names.description: The names the refusal concerns, as dev.qory.run.refused contains them. A name never carries a value, except the run credential's own value in target_differs_from_credential and differs_from_credential, <member>=<the run credential's value>. Absent when the refusal concerns none.

message.description: The error's text of a run that fails to open for a reason without a code, a 500 with the code internal, which the session returns as its error. One line, no control character. It holds no secret, no run credential and no image reference.

from.description: Who refused: gateway, the gateway itself, or apiary, the server, whose refusal the gateway passes on with its code and status.
